acceptancePoints.title: 地图必须展示临近节点服务过程
acceptancePoints.acceptance: 开头2秒同时有标题与远源站/临近服务冲突；渐进展示多地节点，仅被选中节点和当前路径高亮；同一用户、节点和图片跨镜可追踪。保留地图示意说明，旁白用合适/通常网络时延较低，不宣称始终地理最近或每次最短直线。
acceptancePoints.currentGap: 旧visual-direction3写避免世界地图，Main只有横排节点及其他节点文字，没有空间分布主线。用户本轮要求应优先落实。

acceptancePoints.title: 未命中、返回与留下副本必须按顺序
acceptancePoints.acceptance: 本例先用户到所选edge检查未命中，再向源站；内容经edge回给用户，符合规则后该edge留下可复用副本；不让其他地图节点自动同步有图，不承诺首次必快。允许边收边转发，不强制收完整图才转发。

acceptancePoints.title: 命中短返与CDN术语在同一解释点兑现
acceptancePoints.acceptance: 第二访客设定为同服务区域/同一节点，追同一公开图片；请求到达查得可复用副本后才返回，源站支路无本次取图流。多地节点的作用可见时点明内容分发网络（CDN），缩写逐字母读并对齐实际起音，完整显示至少63帧。

acceptancePoints.title: 把具体miss例子与普遍回源条件分清
acceptancePoints.acceptance: 本例无图所以回源；不能扩成只有miss才可能联系源站。过期验证/更新、私人响应不共享等只保留必要短限定，更多协议分支留文章；上层缓存可让边缘miss不必直达origin。结尾不承诺修复程序/数据库慢，无虚构毫秒倍数。
acceptancePoints.sourceRisk: 旧Main09 refresh完成时用户image=true但state固定等待检查，且仅origin→edge返回流，无edge→user动作；新版应同步接收态及返回路径。此为源码风险，尚未以新版实际帧确认。

officialSourcesActuallyAccessed.title: AWS How CloudFront delivers content
officialSourcesActuallyAccessed.actualRead: Body: request delivery steps and regional edge cache sections; official implementation example, not universal topology.
officialSourcesActuallyAccessed.supports: Suitable edge typically by latency; cache hit local reply; cache miss may use regional cache or origin; forwarding may start at first byte.

officialSourcesActuallyAccessed.title: IETF RFC9111 HTTP Caching
officialSourcesActuallyAccessed.actualRead: Body overview and sections4,4.2.4,4.3,5.2.2.7 through open/find tool excerpts.
officialSourcesActuallyAccessed.supports: Reuse requires matching and permitted response; stale handling/validation are conditional; unqualified private prohibits shared storage.

officialSourcesActuallyAccessed.title: Cloudflare Default cache behavior
officialSourcesActuallyAccessed.actualRead: Default behavior and request collapsing body; document update visible Sep14 2026.
officialSourcesActuallyAccessed.supports: Storage depends on headers/configuration; vendor defaults are not all-CDN protocol guarantees.
